==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. Small slime aliens rained down from the sky. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Slime aliens resemble cylinders of slime. Small slime aliens are no bigger than a tin-can. Large slime aliens, Slime alien leaders, are half the size of a human man. As far as I know, there is only one Slime alien leader.)
The leader of the slime aliens ate me, in an attempt to steal the Reality Warping Stone. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
I used the stone's power to turn the leader into a symbiote suit, granting me control over all of the slime aliens.
